name: Dont Mess With Cthulhu
summary: Secret-identity social deduction where Investigators hunt Elder Signs and Cultists try to reveal Cthulhu before time runs out.
rules_text: Setup: for 4-6 players use 3-4 Investigators vs 2 Cultists, plus extra hidden tokens, shuffle and deal one role face down to each player. Build Investigation deck per player count with Futile cards, Elder Signs equal to player count, and one Cthulhu, shuffle and deal five to each player face down. Each player looks at own cards, notes counts but shuffles so positions unknown, then may lie about contents. Play is four rounds. Each round has actions equal to player count. Active player chooses one face-down Investigation card belonging to another player and reveals it. If Cthulhu is revealed Cultists win instantly. If all Elder Signs revealed Investigators win instantly. Otherwise the owner of the revealed card becomes next Active player. After actions equal to player count, collect remaining face-down cards, reshuffle and redeal evenly, one fewer per player each round. After four rounds without all Signs, Cultists win.
rating_reason: Social deduction secret identities, bluffing, no board needed.
